final: WITH account_transactions AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND c.town_city != '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), town_totals AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS total_transactions_in_town FROM account_transactions GROUP BY town_city), overall_stats AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_accounts, SUM(transaction_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_per_account FROM account_transactions) SELECT at.account_id, at.town_city, at.transaction_count, at.transaction_count * 1.0 / tt.total_transactions_in_town AS share_in_town, at.transaction_count / os.avg_per_account AS ratio_to_average FROM account_transactions at JOIN town_totals tt ON at.town_city = tt.town_city CROSS JOIN overall_stats os ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
